Response B also adds a "no gap" argument: if two reals differ, some number lies between them, and none does here. It then explains why a "0.000...1" difference is not a valid decimal, which addresses a common misconception directly.

Response B also fits the user's under-120-word limit (roughly 110 words). Response A runs closer to 160 words, so it breaks that constraint. Its extra sentences mostly restate the limit idea and add little.
